name: Confused Mr. Krabs
look: A SpongeBob SquarePants still with a heavy spinning blur. Mr. Krabs, the red crab, stands in the center with his eyes up on their stalks and his mouth open in bewilderment, while a crowd of blurry fish townspeople surrounds him.
use: Shows feeling completely lost, overwhelmed or disoriented. The caption describes the confusing moment, like walking into an exam after skipping every lecture or opening a group chat with hundreds of unread messages.
examples: Me opening the group chat after 300 unread messages
Me walking into the exam after skipping every lecture
describe: mr krabs spinning and blurry surrounded by fish
spongebob crab lost in the middle of a crowd
dizzy crab with wide eyes in a blurred spinning shot
cartoon crab disoriented and looking around
blurred red crab who has no idea what is going on
origin: A blurred still of Mr. Krabs from the animated series SpongeBob SquarePants.
